first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: The bald person in the left foreground, with their back to the camera, broad, thick shoulders and back, light-colored skin with broad red markings, and weapons carried on their back.

entities.name: Person B
entities.identification: The person with long black hair in the midground, wearing a fitted green outfit and gray-blue hanging panels, holding a bow toward image-right.

entities.name: Person C
entities.identification: The short-haired person in the right midground, straddling Animal A and wearing a light gray-blue top and dark trousers.

entities.name: Animal A
entities.identification: The large gray-brown quadruped in the right midground, with thick curved horns, blue eyes, and golden armor on its head and back, carrying Person C.

entities.name: Dark Red Tree Canopy
entities.identification: The dark red and pink clusters of leaves and dark branching limbs in the upper part of the image.

entities.name: Weapon A
entities.identification: The silver-gray pointed tip and connected shaft segment extending diagonally toward the upper right of the image beside Person A; use this visible portion to identify Weapon A.

entities.name: Orange-Patterned Object Lying on the Ground
entities.identification: The low-lying, irregular orange-brown object on the ground between Person B and Animal A, with dark markings on its surface.

entities.name: Weapon B
entities.identification: The long-handled axe on Person A's back near image-right, with a broad silver-gray axe head and a long brown handle.

entities.name: Weapon C
entities.identification: The slender bow held by Person B, with alternating dark and light bands on its body and an overall nearly vertical orientation.

entities.name: Stone-Framed Wooden-Stake Gate
entities.identification: The dark green-gray rectangular stone frame in the background and the orange-brown vertical row of wooden stakes within it.

entities.name: Torch Beside the Gate
entities.identification: The slender dark pole beside the gate and its yellow-orange flame, with part of the pole occluded.

entities.name: Gray Stone Wall
entities.identification: The gray stone walls in the courtyard background and on image-right, locally very dark, with an irregular upper edge.

entities.name: Gnarled Vines on the Wall
entities.identification: The thick light gray-brown roots, slender vines, and attached green vegetation climbing across the background wall.

entities.name: Courtyard Stone-Paved Ground
entities.identification: The blue-gray-green flagstones, gravel, and reddish-brown strip-like ground bands extending from the foreground to the midground.

entities.name: Ground Moss
entities.identification: The low green cover among the midground grass and flagstones, locally mixed with broader leaves.

entities.name: Courtyard Fungal Clusters
entities.identification: The clustered red-orange umbrella-shaped and sheet-like fungal forms on the ground.

entities.name: Weapon D
entities.identification: The long silver-gray curved blade slanting across Person A's back, with a dark brown grip near the back of the neck.

At frame 0, Person C is a short-haired person wearing a light gray-blue top and dark trousers, with a dark belt at the waist; the upper body is upright, and both hands are near the front of the body.

At frame 0, Person C is a short-haired person wearing a light gray-blue top, dark belt, and dark trousers; the neckline has dark overlapping edging, the cuffs have segmented bands of color, and the forearms and wrists have darker coverings. The legs are positioned on either side of the saddle, the upper body is upright, and both hands are near the front of the body.

At frame 0, Animal A is a large gray-brown quadruped with thick curved horns on both sides of its head, golden armor plates covering its head and back, and saddle gear; its head is lowered, and its face is oriented toward the camera side.

At frame 0, Animal A is a large gray-brown quadruped with dark texture across its coat and darker lower legs. Its lowered face is oriented toward the camera side, revealing a light-colored muzzle, blue eyes, and light-colored pointed protrusions at the mouth. Thick curved horns flank its head, the golden head armor has multiple ridges, and continuous golden armor plates and saddle gear cover its back.
At frame 0, the appearance of the Dark Red Tree Canopy is as follows: it consists of large dark red and pink clusters of leaves and dark branching limbs.

At frame 0, the visible details of the Dark Red Tree Canopy are as follows: layered dark red and pink clusters of leaves, with pointed leaf tips and light-colored highlights along some leaf edges; slender dark brown branches fork repeatedly, with deep dark gaps visible among the branches and leaves.
At frame 0, the appearance of the Orange-Patterned Object Lying on the Ground is as follows: it is orange-brown, with a low-lying irregular outline and dark markings on its surface.

At frame 0, the visible details of the Orange-Patterned Object Lying on the Ground are as follows: its low-lying orange-brown surface has irregular dark patches and short stripes, its upper edge has uneven rises and dips, and its edges are partially occluded by grass blades and small red pieces.
At frame 0, Weapon B is a long-handled axe with a broad silver-gray axe head and a long straight brown handle.

At frame 0, Weapon B is a long-handled axe. Its broad silver-gray axe head has a curved cutting edge, mottled light and dark texture, and a dark opening near the axe neck. The long straight brown handle extends downward, and a metallic connector and localized golden highlights are visible where the head joins the handle.
At frame 0, Weapon C is a slender bow with an overall nearly vertical orientation, alternating dark and light bands on its body, and a string drawn into a diagonal line.

At frame 0, Weapon C is a slender, nearly vertical bow with a slightly curved body and continuous diagonal bands alternating between dark and light across its surface. Within the frame, orange-brown wooden stakes are arranged vertically and vary in thickness; some tops are pointed and slanted, their heights are uneven, and dark gaps lie between the stakes.
